project.title: Modulating microalgae- bacteria consortia for efficient wastewater remediation
project.description: This study aimed to demonstrate the potential of upcycling dairy side-streams into premium animal feed ingredients via the microalga Nannochloropsis limnetica. The 16S rRNA data provided here characterises the bacterial communities associated with Nannochloropsis limnetica during a two-stage cultivation experiment. During the first stage either Bold's Basal Medium or dairy wastewater used as a growth medium, and in the second stage whey permeate was used as a growth medium. Bacterial samples were collected across multiple days.
